r("Record shortcuts","With a display or Window… source, writes each keyboard shortcut and when you type, never what you type, into the recording's cursor files.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record shortcuts"],[RS+" keys"],[IM],["Default off.","A note under it says what it records.","Greyed out, keeping its value, with Camera or Microphone Only."])
r("When it lands: Zoom in on clicks","After the recording lands, runs Auto Zoom on its screen clips.",[PANEL+" ▸ When it lands: ▸ Zoom in on clicks"],[RS+" auto_zoom"],details=["Default on.","Greyed out, keeping its value, with Camera or Microphone Only, or during a recording."])
r("When it lands: Show shortcuts","After the recording lands, runs Add Shortcut Overlays on its screen clips.",[PANEL+" ▸ When it lands: ▸ Show shortcuts"],[RS+" shortcut_overlays"],[IM],["Default on (with Record shortcuts).","Live only with Record shortcuts ticked; greyed out, keeping its value, otherwise."])
r("When it lands: Speed up typing","After the recording lands, runs Speed Up Typing on its screen clips once their speech is detected.",[PANEL+" ▸ When it lands: ▸ Speed up typing"],[RS+" speed_up_typing"],[IM],["Default off.","Live only with Record shortcuts ticked; greyed out, keeping its value, otherwise."])
r("Recording Rate","Sets the most frames per second the file may hold, and the frame rate of a new project made from the recording.",[PANEL+" ▸ Rate"],[RS+" rate"],details=["30 fps or 60 fps; default 60 fps."])
r("Recording Size","Nominal (points) records the display at its point size; Best (pixels) records every pixel, twice the points on Retina.",[PANEL+" ▸ Size"],[RS+" size"],details=["Default Nominal (points)."])
r("Record Into","Chooses where the recording lands: New Project or any open project by name.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record Into"],[RS+" project"],details=["Default: the front project, else New Project.","Follows the front project until you choose a row yourself; then keeps your choice while that project stays open.","Freezes when you press Record, so switching windows during the recording doesn't change the destination."])
r("Size note","A note under Size shows what you'll get for the chosen source.",[PANEL+" ▸ note under Size"],details=["A display: e.g. 1728×1117 points · 3456×2234 pixels.","A picked window: \"the picked window's own size\".","Microphone Only: \"no picture — the microphone alone\".","Camera: e.g. 1760×1328 at 30 fps — the camera's best format; 1920×1080 at 30 fps — the chosen format; or \"no camera connected\"."])
r("Panel footnote: save location and elapsed time","The footnote at the bottom left shows where recordings are saved, and the elapsed time while a recording runs.",[PANEL+" ▸ footnote"],details=["For example: saved in ~/Movies/Frame Job Recordings."])
r("Panel remembers your choices","The panel keeps display, microphone, camera, camera format, switches, rate, size, the boxes, Layout and the Remove background box between uses.",[PANEL],details=["Cursor is remembered only once you choose it; until then it shows Separate, and a choice holds for every source.","The camera format is one choice for every camera; a camera without it shows Best.","Not remembered: a picked window, the Camera or Microphone Only source (session only), Record Into.","A display, microphone or camera no longer connected falls back to the main display, Off or the default camera."])
r("Device lists follow hot-plug","While the panel is up and not recording, the Camera and Microphone lists follow devices you plug in or remove.",[PANEL],details=["A change during a recording waits for it to end.","A removed camera falls back to the default camera; when it returns it is chosen again with its format.","Plugging or removing a device doesn't change what the panel remembers."])

sec("Choosing what to record")
r("Record a display","Records a display chosen by name in Source.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ <display>"],[RS+" display"],[SR],["The recorder panel itself is never in the picture, even with Include Frame Job windows on.","The panel leaves the screen as soon as the recording starts."])
r("Frame Job's own sound is never recorded","You can play the timeline during a recording and its sound won't end up in the file.",[PANEL+" ▸ System Audio"],[RS],details=["True with or without Include Frame Job windows."])
r("Record a single window","Choose Window… and pick a window with macOS's picker; the recording is that window alone, at its own size.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ Window…"],[RS+" window"],[SR],["Source then reads Window (picked).","Cancelling the picker returns Source to the display used last.","If the picker can't open, Source goes back and the note reads \"The window picker could not open: …\".","Pressing Record with nothing picked says \"Choose a window with Window… first, or pick a display.\" and nothing records."])
r("Window picker respects Include Frame Job windows","With the box off the picker lists none of Frame Job's windows; with it on it lists them, never the recorder panel.",[PANEL+" ▸ Window…"],details=["The box only changes the next time the picker opens; an already picked window stays picked."])
r("Record a camera on its own","With Source set to Camera, records the chosen camera at the chosen Format's highest frame rate.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ Camera"],[RS+" source: camera"],[CAM],["System Audio, Show Clicks, Size, Include Frame Job windows and Rate grey out, values kept.","Best is the largest size wider than tall that runs at 30 fps or more.","Microphone and Record Into stay live; the microphone, which may be the camera's own, is its own file beside the movie; Off records the camera alone.","No camera: Record says \"No camera is connected.\"","Only the Camera permission (and Microphone when chosen) is checked; Screen Recording isn't needed."])
r("Camera warm-up before recording","The camera starts as soon as the panel shows Camera, so it has settled at its frame rate by the time recording begins.",[PANEL],[],[CAM],["Its light stays on while the panel shows Camera.","Choosing another source (unless Record the camera too is ticked) or closing the panel turns it off."])
r("Preview status messages","Instead of the picture the Preview explains why there isn't one.",[PANEL+" ▸ Preview"],details=["\"No camera is connected.\"","\"The preview shows once Frame Job may use the camera.\" until the permission is allowed; showing the panel never asks, pressing Record does.","The reason the camera couldn't start; choosing Camera again or reopening the panel tries again."])
r("Panel stays up during camera recordings","While a camera records the panel stays up: controls lock, the meter stays live, the footnote shows ● or ❚❚ and the time, Record reads Stop and a Pause / Resume button appears.",[PANEL+" ▸ Stop, Pause / Resume"],details=["Closing the panel doesn't stop the recording."])
r("Where a camera recording lands","The movie lands on the front track if it fits, else a new front track, with the microphone on a new back track named Microphone.",[PANEL],[RS],details=["As a new project, the canvas is the movie's size at the format's frame rate."])
r("Camera stopped on its own","If the camera stops (for example, unplugged) the recording ends there and what was captured lands.",[PANEL+" note"],[RS],details=["The note gives the reason followed by \"What was captured was added.\"","If the camera hadn't settled at its rate when recording began, the note says what rate it ran at."])
r("Record a camera beside the screen","Records the screen and a camera at once, for a talking head over a screencast.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source: display or Window… + Record the camera too"],[RS+" camera, camera_format"],[SR,CAM],["System Audio, Show Clicks, Size, Include Frame Job windows and Rate stay live and apply to the screen; the Size note describes the screen.","The camera starts when the box is ticked; unticking, choosing Microphone Only or closing the panel turns it off.","No camera: Record says \"No camera is connected.\"","Record checks Screen Recording, then Camera, then Microphone when chosen, then counts down.","The panel leaves the screen and the menu-bar item is its only control."])
r("Camera track landing","Each stretch's camera movie, named after its screen movie with \" (Camera)\", goes on one new track named Camera in front of everything, lined up with the screen.",[PANEL],[RS+" camera"],details=["Laid out as Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸ lays it out with the stretch's screen clip."])
r("Camera layout: Corner","Puts the camera in the bottom-right corner, scaled to fit a box a quarter of the canvas wide and a third tall, inside the 90 % guide of View ▸ Safe Areas.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Corner"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_square"],details=["The default."])
r("Camera layout: Rounded Corner","The same bottom-right corner with rounded edges.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Rounded Corner"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_rounded"])
r("Camera layout: Circle","The same bottom-right corner as a circle.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Circle"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_circle"])
r("Camera layout: Side by Side","Puts the screen and the camera next to each other.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Side by Side"],[RS+" camera_layout: side_by_side"])
r("Camera layout: Camera Full","Fills the canvas with the camera.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Camera Full"],[RS+" camera_layout: camera_full"])
r("Layout scope per stretch","The layout starts at the camera clip's first frame and reaches no further than that stretch's screen or camera clip.",[],details=["The screen keeps its full picture until the camera arrives.","A clip already in the project never moves; another stretch's screen without a camera stays full.","If a stretch's screen clip isn't playing where its camera starts, that camera goes in the bottom-right corner instead."])
r("Remove Background undo step on landing","With the box ticked, camera clips get Remove Background as their own undo step, before Enhance and the When it lands boxes.",["Edit ▸ Undo"],details=["Undo takes it off and keeps the recording."])
r("Camera clips stay ordinary clips","Each camera clip can be moved or given another layout afterwards.",["Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸"],area="recording")
r("Preview while a tool records the camera","If a tool records a camera while the panel is up, the Preview reads \"The camera is recording.\" until it ends.",[PANEL+" ▸ Preview"],[RS])

sec("Recording")
r("Countdown","Pressing Record checks permissions then shows a 3, 2, 1 countdown in the panel; the microphone meter already moves so you can check your level.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record"],details=["The Record button reads Cancel; Cancel or closing the panel stops it and nothing is recorded.","Afterwards the panel leaves the screen, or stays up with Camera or Microphone Only."])
r("Start timeout and early Stop","The button reads Starting… while recording starts, and the panel handles a start that fails or is abandoned.",[PANEL+" ▸ Starting…","File ▸ Stop Recording"],details=["After 20 seconds: \"The recording did not start within 20 s.\" and back to idle.","A Stop during Starting… abandons it: \"Stopped before the recording began; nothing was recorded.\""])
r("One recording at a time","Pressing Record while another recording runs or is paused, including one an agent started, is refused.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record"],[RS],details=["\"A recording is already in progress.\""])
r("Menu-bar recording item","While a recording runs, the menu bar shows a coral ● and the elapsed time, with a menu to pause, resume and stop.",["Menu-bar item"],[RS],details=["Time is m:ss, or h:mm:ss past an hour.","Recording: ● and the running time; menu Pause Recording, Stop Recording.","Paused: ❚❚ and the time held still; menu Resume Recording, Stop Recording.","Keeps one fixed width so other items don't shift; a little wider with the keyboard mark.","Comes down as soon as the recording stops."])
r("Menu-bar keyboard mark","While a recording records shortcuts, a ⌨︎ mark follows the ● or ❚❚ and the menu starts with a greyed-out Recording keyboard shortcuts row.",["Menu-bar item"],[RS+" keys"],details=["Holds for a recording an agent started too."])
r("Pause and Resume Recording","Pauses and resumes a running recording from the menu-bar item or the File menu.",["Menu-bar item","File ▸ Pause Recording / Resume Recording (no shortcut)",PANEL+" ▸ Pause / Resume (camera and voice-over)"],details=["The File item sits directly under New Recording… and works only while a recording runs.","There is no MCP tool for pause or resume."])
r("Stop Recording","Stops a running or paused recording; while one runs File ▸ New Recording… reads Stop Recording.",["File ▸ Stop Recording (⌥⌘N)","Menu-bar item"])
r("Welcome button during a recording","The welcome window's New Recording… never stops a recording: it beeps during a screen recording and shows the panel during a camera recording or voice-over.",["Welcome window ▸ New Recording…"])
r("Stop from macOS's indicator","macOS's own screen-recording indicator can stop the recording; Frame Job keeps what was captured and adds it.",["macOS menu-bar indicator"],[RS+" stopped_by: user_stopped"])
r("Quit is held during a recording","Choosing Quit during a recording doesn't quit: it opens the menu-bar item's menu, or shows the panel for a camera recording or voice-over.",["Frame Job ▸ Quit Frame Job (⌘Q)"])
r("Paused recordings are stretches","A pause ends the current file and a resume starts a new one, each named by its stretch's start time; they land end to end on one track.",[],[RS+" segments, pauses"],details=["The stretches touch, with no transition between them.","Each stretch's microphone file goes on the Microphone track, lined up with its picture.","The paused time is in no file; elapsed time counts only what was recorded."])

sec("Where it lands")
r("Stopping and Adding status","When you stop, the panel's button reads Stopping… then Adding… while the files are written and imported.",[PANEL])
r("Land into an open project","The recording goes into the Record Into project at its playhead, in whatever container is open, including inside a nest.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record Into"],[RS+" project"],details=["Picture on the front track if it fits, else a new track in front.","Microphone on a new back track named Microphone.","The new clips are selected."])
r("Add Recording undo step","Everything landed in an open project is one undo step, Add Recording.",["Edit ▸ Undo"],details=["Undo removes the clips and media entries but leaves the files on disk, like undoing Add Media…."])
r("Waits for a drag to end","If you're mid-drag in the project when the recording stops, Frame Job waits up to 20 seconds before adding it.",[],details=["After that it gives up and the panel names the files, which are on disk either way."])
r("Target project closed during recording","If the chosen project was closed while recording, the recording opens as a new project and the panel says so.",[PANEL+" note"])
r("Land as a new project","With Record Into set to New Project, the recording opens as a project named after its file, with the canvas at the movie's size and the Rate you chose.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record Into ▸ New Project"],[RS],details=["The name, e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22, is what Save offers.","The first stretch's picture is the project itself, so it has no undo step.","Later stretches, the microphone and a camera are one undo step: Add Microphone, Add Camera, Add Camera and Microphone, or Add Recording Segments.","The project is unsaved and asks before it closes."])
r("Enhancing the microphone on landing","Runs Enhance Voice on each stretch's microphone file or a voice-over's files after they land, never touching the picture, a camera or the system audio.",[PANEL+" ▸ Enhance the microphone when it lands","Measuring Sound sheet"],[RS+" enhance","enhance_voice"],[MIC],["Waits a few seconds for loudness and speech analysis, then runs under the Measuring Sound sheet at Normalize's target loudness.","Its settings appear in the clip's Sound tab.","Own undo step, Enhance Voice, after the landing's; undo keeps the recording.","Cancel on the sheet leaves the clips as they landed.","Waits during a drag, while a sheet is up, or while you're in another nest.","With nothing to enhance, or no analysis within 5 minutes, the reason appears at the foot of the inspector; use Clip ▸ Enhance Voice yourself."],area="audio")
r("When it lands: automatic polish sequence","Ticked boxes run in order on the recording's screen clips after any Enhance: Auto Zoom, Add Shortcut Overlays, Speed Up Typing.",[PANEL+" ▸ When it lands:"],[RS+" auto_zoom, shortcut_overlays, speed_up_typing"],details=["Screen clips are those of each stretch's movie that has a cursor file.","No sheet comes up; each is its own undo step, undone last first, keeping the recording.","Zooms are planned before the speed-up splits clips, and the speed-up leaves each overlay at its pace.","Each waits during a drag, while a sheet is up, or while you're in another nest.","A refusal appears at the foot of the inspector and the next one still runs.","A busy project or undetected speech for 5 minutes is reported and the rest don't run.","A recording with no cursor file, or a command with nothing to do, changes nothing and says nothing."])
r("Zoom in on clicks uses remembered values","On landing it runs Auto Zoom with the values the sheet last used, Zoom on typing on when the recording has typing.",[PANEL+" ▸ Zoom in on clicks"])
r("Show shortcuts landing style","On landing it runs Add Shortcut Overlays at the bottom, in the dark theme.",[PANEL+" ▸ Show shortcuts"])
r("Speed up typing on landing","On landing it runs Speed Up Typing with the sheet's last values once the microphone's speech is detected, so typing you talk over keeps its pace.",[PANEL+" ▸ Speed up typing"],details=["A speed-up that would leave a clip silent above ×12 is never applied without asking; choose Clip ▸ Speed Up Typing… yourself to be asked."])
r("Panel returns only with something to say","A clean landing doesn't bring the panel back; it returns on its own, with a note, only if it was on screen when recording began and there's something to report.",[PANEL+" note"],details=["Stopped from macOS's indicator, display slept or went away, camera stopped on its own.","Chosen project closed, so it opened as new.","A stretch's movie unreadable and left out; its microphone still lands and the next picture starts after the gap; the note names left-out and kept files; only a recording with no readable movie fails.","\"The recording did not finish writing within 10 s.\" naming the kept files.","The microphone stopped or failed (the picture still landed).","A resume failed.","A file couldn't be placed and was added to the media list only.","\"The recording was saved at … but could not be added: …\" naming every file."])

sec("Files and formats")
r("Recordings folder","Recordings are saved in ~/Movies/Frame Job Recordings/, created the first time it's needed, and never stored inside the project package.",[],[RS+" path"],details=["Use Consolidate to carry them into the package."])
r("Screen recording file format","A QuickTime movie in HEVC, or H.264 where HEVC isn't available, with system audio as one stereo 48 kHz track.",[],details=["Named e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22.mov."])
r("Microphone file format","The microphone is a mono 48 kHz AAC file beside the movie.",[],details=["Named e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22 (Microphone).m4a."])
r("Voice-over file format","A voice-over is a mono 48 kHz AAC file.",[],details=["Named e.g. Voice-over 2026-10-02 at 09.15.04.m4a."])
r("Camera recording file format","A QuickTime movie at the camera's format, HEVC or H.264, with no sound of its own; its microphone file sits beside it.",[],details=["Named e.g. Camera Recording 2026-10-26 at 17.14.33.mov."])
r("Cursor file (.fjcursor)","Beside every screen recording's movie, one per stretch, a file records the pointer about 120 times a second, every click and scroll, and how the recorded area sat on the screen.",[],details=["Made for a display, a window or a picked window.","With In the picture the pointer is drawn into the movie as well.","If the file can't be written the recording still lands and the note says why."])
r("Name collisions","When a recording's name is taken, Frame Job adds (2), (3) and so on.")
r("Microphone kept separate and aligned","The microphone is always separate from system audio so each level can be set independently, and it is placed to match the measured start offset.",[],[RS+" mic_offset"],details=["Its head is trimmed if it started first."])
r("Variable frame rate from a still screen","macOS delivers frames only when the screen changes, so the file's rate may be low and uneven; Rate is the file's maximum.",[PANEL+" ▸ Rate"],details=["A new project uses Rate as its frame rate; the media entry keeps the file's real rate.","Where the picture stops changing before the sound ends, the last frame is held to the clip's end."])

sec("The cursor")
r("Cursor file travels with landing","When a recording lands, each stretch's movie gets its own cursor file.")
r("Cursor file found on import","Importing a movie looks beside it for a same-named .fjcursor and takes it only if it reads as a cursor file made for exactly this movie's size.",["File ▸ Add Media…","drop","open"],["import_media"],details=["A missing, damaged or wrong-size file is left alone and the movie imports without it.","A copy Frame Job makes of a WebM or Matroska file is not looked beside."],area="media")
r("Cursor file on relink","Relinking takes the cursor file beside the new movie, else keeps the existing one if it's still there and the new movie is the same size.",["Relink…","Media tab"],["relink_media"],details=["Otherwise the media has no cursor file after the relink."],area="media")
r("Cursor file on consolidate","Consolidate copies the cursor file into the package beside its movie, and a moved package finds it again.",["Consolidate Media"],["consolidate_media"],area="media")
r("Media tab Cursor section","Selecting a recording in the Media tab names its cursor file, says \"No cursor file\", or adds \"— missing\".",["Media tab ▸ Cursor"],area="media")
r("Locate cursor file","Chooses a .fjcursor file for a recording, taken only if it's a cursor file made for exactly this size; otherwise says why and changes nothing.",["Media tab ▸ Cursor ▸ Locate…"],["set_media_cursor"],details=["Undo name \"Locate Cursor File\"."],area="media")
r("Remove cursor file","Forgets the cursor file, which stays on disk.",["Media tab ▸ Cursor ▸ Remove"],["set_media_cursor"],details=["Undo name \"Remove Cursor File\"."],area="media")
r("get_cursor_events","Agents read a recording's clicks, scrolls, shortcuts, typing stretches and pointer path, in the file's time or a clip's, with each click's place in the clip's zoom region frame.",[],["get_cursor_events"],area="mcp")
r("Clip Cursor section","A clip whose movie has a cursor file the picture doesn't already show gets a Cursor section, after Background; each row is its own undo step.",["Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Cursor"],details=["Starts closed; its summary says off, on or arrow, with + ripples when clicks ripple."])
C="Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Cursor ▸ "
r("Show cursor","Draws the pointer from the file over the clip.",[C+"Show cursor"],details=["On by default.","With an action selected it switches at the action's end."])
r("Cursor Size","Sets how big the pointer is drawn.",[C+"Size"],details=["25–800 %; quick picks 50, 100, 150, 200 and 400 %; the slider runs to 400 %, the field to 800 %.","Animates across a selected action."])
r("Cursor Style","As recorded draws the file's pointer images; Arrow draws Frame Job's own arrow.",[C+"Style"],details=["Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Cursor Smoothing","Calms a shaky path while still passing exactly through every click and holding still where it held still.",[C+"Smoothing"],details=["Off, Light, Medium, Strong.","Belongs to the clip, not an action: the row shows ⊘ with an action selected."])
r("Hide when idle","Fades the pointer out after a set time with no movement or click and brings it back just before it next moves.",[C+"Hide when idle"],details=["Never, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s.","Belongs to the clip, not an action."])
r("Clicks: Ripple","Draws a ring growing out of every click.",[C+"Clicks"],details=["None or Ripple.","Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Ripple color","Sets the ring's colour, with opacity.",[C+"Ripple color"],details=["Live only while Clicks is Ripple.","Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Ripple size","Sets how big the ring grows.",[C+"Ripple size"],details=["25–400 %.","Live only while Clicks is Ripple.","Animates across a selected action."])
r("Polish","Sets Smoothing to Medium and Hide when idle to 3 s in one step.",[C+"Polish"],details=["Belongs to the clip, not an action."])
r("Cursor settings through actions","With an action selected, Size and Ripple size animate across it and the other rows switch at its end.",[C.rstrip(" ▸")],details=["A clip with no cursor settings gets them the first time you change a row other than Smoothing or Hide when idle with an action selected, so they animate rather than jump."])
r("Mixed rows and Reset in the Cursor section","Selecting clips that disagree shows a row mixed, and Reset puts every row back to its default.",[C+"Reset"])
r("Frame Job's arrow","The arrow is drawn crisp at any size, at a standard pointer's size times Size, and is used whenever the file recorded no pointer images.",[C+"Style ▸ Arrow"])
r("Paste Attributes carries cursor settings","Paste Attributes carries a clip's cursor settings to another clip with the rest of its picture settings.",["Paste Attributes (⌥⌘V)"],area="editing")
r("Cursor motion blur","With the clip's Motion Blur above 0, a moving pointer is drawn streaked along its path across the shutter; a still pointer and click ripples stay sharp.",["Clip tab ▸ Transform ▸ Motion Blur"],["render_frame"],details=["In the preview, render_frame and every export."],area="motion")
r("What a Separate recording lands with","With Cursor Separate the clip gets a Cursor section with the pointer drawn as recorded; with Show Clicks too, Clicks is Ripple in the same undo step.",[],details=["In a new project whose only other change is that, the undo name is \"Cursor Clicks\".","Nothing else is set; Polish is one click away."])
r("What an In the picture recording lands with","The pointer is in the movie, the cursor file says so, and the clip shows no Cursor section, so nothing is drawn twice.")

sec("Shortcuts and Input Monitoring")
r("Recorded shortcuts","Each shortcut is written with its keys spelled out, for example cmd+shift+4.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record shortcuts"],["get_cursor_events"],[IM],["A key held with ⌘ or ⌃ is a shortcut; so is ⌥ with an arrow, Delete, Forward Delete, Return, Enter, Tab or Esc.","⇧ alone never makes one, nor ⌥ with any other key.","Modifiers come first in the order cmd, ctrl, opt, shift, then a named key or the unmodified character lowercased; + is spelled plus."])
r("Typing marks","Every other key press, and every key held until it repeats, is recorded as a time only, never which key.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record shortcuts"],["get_cursor_events"],[IM],["Frame Job doesn't read the character of a typed key at all."])
r("Secure input privacy","Nothing is recorded while any app holds secure input, not even a typing mark.",[],details=["A password field without secure input, such as a Terminal sudo prompt with Secure Keyboard Entry off, is recorded as typing marks only.","Keys pressed while paused aren't recorded.","There is no mode that records what you type."])

sec("Auto Zoom")
A="Clip ▸ Auto Zoom… ▸ "
r("Auto Zoom","Zooms a screen recording in where things happen, from its cursor file: arriving before each click, staying while you work, zooming back out when you stop.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],["auto_zoom"],details=["Each zoom is an ordinary action you can move, retime, change or delete.","The whole plan is one undo step, Auto Zoom.","Works inside an open nest.","Greyed when a selected clip is not a movie with a cursor file."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Zoom","How far in, as a multiple of the clip's own size.",[A+"Zoom"],["auto_zoom"],details=["2× default; 1.25–4."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Arrive","How many seconds before a click the zoom-in starts.",[A+"Arrive"],["auto_zoom"],details=["0.6 s default; 0.2–2."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Stay","How long the zoom holds after the last click or typing.",[A+"Stay"],["auto_zoom"],details=["2.5 s default; 0.5–10."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Follow the cursor while zoomed","Pans along when the pointer stays near the edge of the zoomed view.",[A+"Follow the cursor while zoomed"],["auto_zoom"],details=["On by default.","Adds a half-second pan when the pointer stays outside the middle 70 % of the view for 0.3 s, at most one a second."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Zoom on typing","Zooms in on stretches of typing too, aimed at the last click before them.",[A+"Zoom on typing"],["auto_zoom"],[],["On when there is typing; greyed when the recording holds none.","Never remembered."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Replace existing zooms","Removes the clips' existing zooms first; off keeps your own.",[A+"Replace existing zooms"],["auto_zoom"],details=["Off by default.","Only zooms are removed, never a speed change, a fade or anything else."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Motion blur","Gives each zoomed clip a 50 % motion blur (a 180° shutter) so zooms and pans blur along their movement.",[A+"Motion blur"],["auto_zoom motion_blur"],details=["On by default.","A clip that already has a Motion Blur keeps its own.","Agents: motion_blur 0–1, 0.5 by default; the answer's blurred counts the clips given one."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom sheet summary","The sheet reads the cursor files, then says what Zoom would do, or says why a clip can't be planned.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],details=["\"Reading cursor files…\"","e.g. \"5 zooms in 2 visits.\" and \"1 dropped where an action is already set.\""],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom remembers settings","Zoom, Arrive, Stay, Follow, Replace and Motion blur are remembered for next time, once you change one.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],area="motion")

r("Size note","A note under Size shows what you'll get for the chosen source.",[PANEL+" ▸ note under Size"],details=["A display: e.g. 1728×1117 points · 3456×2234 pixels.","A picked window: \"the picked window's own size\".","Microphone Only: \"no picture — the microphone alone\".","Camera: e.g. 1760×1328 at 30 fps — the camera's best format; 1920×1080 at 30 fps — the chosen format; or \"no camera connected\"."])
r("Panel footnote: save location and elapsed time","The footnote at the bottom left shows where recordings are saved, and the elapsed time while a recording runs.",[PANEL+" ▸ footnote"],details=["For example: saved in ~/Movies/Frame Job Recordings."])
r("Panel remembers your choices","The panel keeps display, microphone, camera, camera format, switches, rate, size, the boxes, Layout and the Remove background box between uses.",[PANEL],details=["Cursor is remembered only once you choose it; until then it shows Separate, and a choice holds for every source.","The camera format is one choice for every camera; a camera without it shows Best.","Not remembered: a picked window, the Camera or Microphone Only source (session only), Record Into.","A display, microphone or camera no longer connected falls back to the main display, Off or the default camera."])
r("Device lists follow hot-plug","While the panel is up and not recording, the Camera and Microphone lists follow devices you plug in or remove.",[PANEL],details=["A change during a recording waits for it to end.","A removed camera falls back to the default camera; when it returns it is chosen again with its format.","Plugging or removing a device doesn't change what the panel remembers."])

sec("Choosing what to record")
r("Record a display","Records a display chosen by name in Source.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ <display>"],[RS+" display"],[SR],["The recorder panel itself is never in the picture, even with Include Frame Job windows on.","The panel leaves the screen as soon as the recording starts."])
r("Frame Job's own sound is never recorded","You can play the timeline during a recording and its sound won't end up in the file.",[PANEL+" ▸ System Audio"],[RS],details=["True with or without Include Frame Job windows."])
r("Record a single window","Choose Window… and pick a window with macOS's picker; the recording is that window alone, at its own size.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ Window…"],[RS+" window"],[SR],["Source then reads Window (picked).","Cancelling the picker returns Source to the display used last.","If the picker can't open, Source goes back and the note reads \"The window picker could not open: …\".","Pressing Record with nothing picked says \"Choose a window with Window… first, or pick a display.\" and nothing records."])
r("Window picker respects Include Frame Job windows","With the box off the picker lists none of Frame Job's windows; with it on it lists them, never the recorder panel.",[PANEL+" ▸ Window…"],details=["The box only changes the next time the picker opens; an already picked window stays picked."])
r("Record a camera on its own","With Source set to Camera, records the chosen camera at the chosen Format's highest frame rate.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source ▸ Camera"],[RS+" source: camera"],[CAM],["System Audio, Show Clicks, Size, Include Frame Job windows and Rate grey out, values kept.","Best is the largest size wider than tall that runs at 30 fps or more.","Microphone and Record Into stay live; the microphone, which may be the camera's own, is its own file beside the movie; Off records the camera alone.","No camera: Record says \"No camera is connected.\"","Only the Camera permission (and Microphone when chosen) is checked; Screen Recording isn't needed."])
r("Camera warm-up before recording","The camera starts as soon as the panel shows Camera, so it has settled at its frame rate by the time recording begins.",[PANEL],[],[CAM],["Its light stays on while the panel shows Camera.","Choosing another source (unless Record the camera too is ticked) or closing the panel turns it off."])
r("Preview status messages","Instead of the picture the Preview explains why there isn't one.",[PANEL+" ▸ Preview"],details=["\"No camera is connected.\"","\"The preview shows once Frame Job may use the camera.\" until the permission is allowed; showing the panel never asks, pressing Record does.","The reason the camera couldn't start; choosing Camera again or reopening the panel tries again."])
r("Panel stays up during camera recordings","While a camera records the panel stays up: controls lock, the meter stays live, the footnote shows ● or ❚❚ and the time, Record reads Stop and a Pause / Resume button appears.",[PANEL+" ▸ Stop, Pause / Resume"],details=["Closing the panel doesn't stop the recording."])
r("Where a camera recording lands","The movie lands on the front track if it fits, else a new front track, with the microphone on a new back track named Microphone.",[PANEL],[RS],details=["As a new project, the canvas is the movie's size at the format's frame rate."])
r("Camera stopped on its own","If the camera stops (for example, unplugged) the recording ends there and what was captured lands.",[PANEL+" note"],[RS],details=["The note gives the reason followed by \"What was captured was added.\"","If the camera hadn't settled at its rate when recording began, the note says what rate it ran at."])
r("Record a camera beside the screen","Records the screen and a camera at once, for a talking head over a screencast.",[PANEL+" ▸ Source: display or Window… + Record the camera too"],[RS+" camera, camera_format"],[SR,CAM],["System Audio, Show Clicks, Size, Include Frame Job windows and Rate stay live and apply to the screen; the Size note describes the screen.","The camera starts when the box is ticked; unticking, choosing Microphone Only or closing the panel turns it off.","No camera: Record says \"No camera is connected.\"","Record checks Screen Recording, then Camera, then Microphone when chosen, then counts down.","The panel leaves the screen and the menu-bar item is its only control."])
r("Camera track landing","Each stretch's camera movie, named after its screen movie with \" (Camera)\", goes on one new track named Camera in front of everything, lined up with the screen.",[PANEL],[RS+" camera"],details=["Laid out as Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸ lays it out with the stretch's screen clip."])
r("Camera layout: Corner","Puts the camera in the bottom-right corner, scaled to fit a box a quarter of the canvas wide and a third tall, inside the 90 % guide of View ▸ Safe Areas.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Corner"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_square"],details=["The default."])
r("Camera layout: Rounded Corner","The same bottom-right corner with rounded edges.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Rounded Corner"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_rounded"])
r("Camera layout: Circle","The same bottom-right corner as a circle.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Circle"],[RS+" camera_layout: corner_circle"])
r("Camera layout: Side by Side","Puts the screen and the camera next to each other.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Side by Side"],[RS+" camera_layout: side_by_side"])
r("Camera layout: Camera Full","Fills the canvas with the camera.",[PANEL+" ▸ Layout ▸ Camera Full"],[RS+" camera_layout: camera_full"])
r("Layout scope per stretch","The layout starts at the camera clip's first frame and reaches no further than that stretch's screen or camera clip.",[],details=["The screen keeps its full picture until the camera arrives.","A clip already in the project never moves; another stretch's screen without a camera stays full.","If a stretch's screen clip isn't playing where its camera starts, that camera goes in the bottom-right corner instead."])
r("Remove Background undo step on landing","With the box ticked, camera clips get Remove Background as their own undo step, before Enhance and the When it lands boxes.",["Edit ▸ Undo"],details=["Undo takes it off and keeps the recording."])
r("Camera clips stay ordinary clips","Each camera clip can be moved or given another layout afterwards.",["Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸"],area="recording")
r("Preview while a tool records the camera","If a tool records a camera while the panel is up, the Preview reads \"The camera is recording.\" until it ends.",[PANEL+" ▸ Preview"],[RS])

sec("Recording")
r("Countdown","Pressing Record checks permissions then shows a 3, 2, 1 countdown in the panel; the microphone meter already moves so you can check your level.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record"],details=["The Record button reads Cancel; Cancel or closing the panel stops it and nothing is recorded.","Afterwards the panel leaves the screen, or stays up with Camera or Microphone Only."])
r("Start timeout and early Stop","The button reads Starting… while recording starts, and the panel handles a start that fails or is abandoned.",[PANEL+" ▸ Starting…","File ▸ Stop Recording"],details=["After 20 seconds: \"The recording did not start within 20 s.\" and back to idle.","A Stop during Starting… abandons it: \"Stopped before the recording began; nothing was recorded.\""])
r("One recording at a time","Pressing Record while another recording runs or is paused, including one an agent started, is refused.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record"],[RS],details=["\"A recording is already in progress.\""])
r("Menu-bar recording item","While a recording runs, the menu bar shows a coral ● and the elapsed time, with a menu to pause, resume and stop.",["Menu-bar item"],[RS],details=["Time is m:ss, or h:mm:ss past an hour.","Recording: ● and the running time; menu Pause Recording, Stop Recording.","Paused: ❚❚ and the time held still; menu Resume Recording, Stop Recording.","Keeps one fixed width so other items don't shift; a little wider with the keyboard mark.","Comes down as soon as the recording stops."])
r("Menu-bar keyboard mark","While a recording records shortcuts, a ⌨︎ mark follows the ● or ❚❚ and the menu starts with a greyed-out Recording keyboard shortcuts row.",["Menu-bar item"],[RS+" keys"],details=["Holds for a recording an agent started too."])
r("Pause and Resume Recording","Pauses and resumes a running recording from the menu-bar item or the File menu.",["Menu-bar item","File ▸ Pause Recording / Resume Recording (no shortcut)",PANEL+" ▸ Pause / Resume (camera and voice-over)"],details=["The File item sits directly under New Recording… and works only while a recording runs.","There is no MCP tool for pause or resume."])
r("Stop Recording","Stops a running or paused recording; while one runs File ▸ New Recording… reads Stop Recording.",["File ▸ Stop Recording (⌥⌘N)","Menu-bar item"])
r("Welcome button during a recording","The welcome window's New Recording… never stops a recording: it beeps during a screen recording and shows the panel during a camera recording or voice-over.",["Welcome window ▸ New Recording…"])
r("Stop from macOS's indicator","macOS's own screen-recording indicator can stop the recording; Frame Job keeps what was captured and adds it.",["macOS menu-bar indicator"],[RS+" stopped_by: user_stopped"])
r("Quit is held during a recording","Choosing Quit during a recording doesn't quit: it opens the menu-bar item's menu, or shows the panel for a camera recording or voice-over.",["Frame Job ▸ Quit Frame Job (⌘Q)"])
r("Paused recordings are stretches","A pause ends the current file and a resume starts a new one, each named by its stretch's start time; they land end to end on one track.",[],[RS+" segments, pauses"],details=["The stretches touch, with no transition between them.","Each stretch's microphone file goes on the Microphone track, lined up with its picture.","The paused time is in no file; elapsed time counts only what was recorded."])

sec("Where it lands")
r("Stopping and Adding status","When you stop, the panel's button reads Stopping… then Adding… while the files are written and imported.",[PANEL])
r("Land into an open project","The recording goes into the Record Into project at its playhead, in whatever container is open, including inside a nest.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record Into"],[RS+" project"],details=["Picture on the front track if it fits, else a new track in front.","Microphone on a new back track named Microphone.","The new clips are selected."])
r("Add Recording undo step","Everything landed in an open project is one undo step, Add Recording.",["Edit ▸ Undo"],details=["Undo removes the clips and media entries but leaves the files on disk, like undoing Add Media…."])
r("Waits for a drag to end","If you're mid-drag in the project when the recording stops, Frame Job waits up to 20 seconds before adding it.",[],details=["After that it gives up and the panel names the files, which are on disk either way."])
r("Target project closed during recording","If the chosen project was closed while recording, the recording opens as a new project and the panel says so.",[PANEL+" note"])
r("Land as a new project","With Record Into set to New Project, the recording opens as a project named after its file, with the canvas at the movie's size and the Rate you chose.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record Into ▸ New Project"],[RS],details=["The name, e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22, is what Save offers.","The first stretch's picture is the project itself, so it has no undo step.","Later stretches, the microphone and a camera are one undo step: Add Microphone, Add Camera, Add Camera and Microphone, or Add Recording Segments.","The project is unsaved and asks before it closes."])
r("Enhancing the microphone on landing","Runs Enhance Voice on each stretch's microphone file or a voice-over's files after they land, never touching the picture, a camera or the system audio.",[PANEL+" ▸ Enhance the microphone when it lands","Measuring Sound sheet"],[RS+" enhance","enhance_voice"],[MIC],["Waits a few seconds for loudness and speech analysis, then runs under the Measuring Sound sheet at Normalize's target loudness.","Its settings appear in the clip's Sound tab.","Own undo step, Enhance Voice, after the landing's; undo keeps the recording.","Cancel on the sheet leaves the clips as they landed.","Waits during a drag, while a sheet is up, or while you're in another nest.","With nothing to enhance, or no analysis within 5 minutes, the reason appears at the foot of the inspector; use Clip ▸ Enhance Voice yourself."],area="audio")
r("When it lands: automatic polish sequence","Ticked boxes run in order on the recording's screen clips after any Enhance: Auto Zoom, Add Shortcut Overlays, Speed Up Typing.",[PANEL+" ▸ When it lands:"],[RS+" auto_zoom, shortcut_overlays, speed_up_typing"],details=["Screen clips are those of each stretch's movie that has a cursor file.","No sheet comes up; each is its own undo step, undone last first, keeping the recording.","Zooms are planned before the speed-up splits clips, and the speed-up leaves each overlay at its pace.","Each waits during a drag, while a sheet is up, or while you're in another nest.","A refusal appears at the foot of the inspector and the next one still runs.","A busy project or undetected speech for 5 minutes is reported and the rest don't run.","A recording with no cursor file, or a command with nothing to do, changes nothing and says nothing."])
r("Zoom in on clicks uses remembered values","On landing it runs Auto Zoom with the values the sheet last used, Zoom on typing on when the recording has typing.",[PANEL+" ▸ Zoom in on clicks"])
r("Show shortcuts landing style","On landing it runs Add Shortcut Overlays at the bottom, in the dark theme.",[PANEL+" ▸ Show shortcuts"])
r("Speed up typing on landing","On landing it runs Speed Up Typing with the sheet's last values once the microphone's speech is detected, so typing you talk over keeps its pace.",[PANEL+" ▸ Speed up typing"],details=["A speed-up that would leave a clip silent above ×12 is never applied without asking; choose Clip ▸ Speed Up Typing… yourself to be asked."])
r("Panel returns only with something to say","A clean landing doesn't bring the panel back; it returns on its own, with a note, only if it was on screen when recording began and there's something to report.",[PANEL+" note"],details=["Stopped from macOS's indicator, display slept or went away, camera stopped on its own.","Chosen project closed, so it opened as new.","A stretch's movie unreadable and left out; its microphone still lands and the next picture starts after the gap; the note names left-out and kept files; only a recording with no readable movie fails.","\"The recording did not finish writing within 10 s.\" naming the kept files.","The microphone stopped or failed (the picture still landed).","A resume failed.","A file couldn't be placed and was added to the media list only.","\"The recording was saved at … but could not be added: …\" naming every file."])

sec("Files and formats")
r("Recordings folder","Recordings are saved in ~/Movies/Frame Job Recordings/, created the first time it's needed, and never stored inside the project package.",[],[RS+" path"],details=["Use Consolidate to carry them into the package."])
r("Screen recording file format","A QuickTime movie in HEVC, or H.264 where HEVC isn't available, with system audio as one stereo 48 kHz track.",[],details=["Named e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22.mov."])
r("Microphone file format","The microphone is a mono 48 kHz AAC file beside the movie.",[],details=["Named e.g. Screen Recording 2026-09-10 at 14.03.22 (Microphone).m4a."])
r("Voice-over file format","A voice-over is a mono 48 kHz AAC file.",[],details=["Named e.g. Voice-over 2026-10-02 at 09.15.04.m4a."])
r("Camera recording file format","A QuickTime movie at the camera's format, HEVC or H.264, with no sound of its own; its microphone file sits beside it.",[],details=["Named e.g. Camera Recording 2026-10-26 at 17.14.33.mov."])
r("Cursor file (.fjcursor)","Beside every screen recording's movie, one per stretch, a file records the pointer about 120 times a second, every click and scroll, and how the recorded area sat on the screen.",[],details=["Made for a display, a window or a picked window.","With In the picture the pointer is drawn into the movie as well.","If the file can't be written the recording still lands and the note says why."])
r("Name collisions","When a recording's name is taken, Frame Job adds (2), (3) and so on.")
r("Microphone kept separate and aligned","The microphone is always separate from system audio so each level can be set independently, and it is placed to match the measured start offset.",[],[RS+" mic_offset"],details=["Its head is trimmed if it started first."])
r("Variable frame rate from a still screen","macOS delivers frames only when the screen changes, so the file's rate may be low and uneven; Rate is the file's maximum.",[PANEL+" ▸ Rate"],details=["A new project uses Rate as its frame rate; the media entry keeps the file's real rate.","Where the picture stops changing before the sound ends, the last frame is held to the clip's end."])

sec("The cursor")
r("Cursor file travels with landing","When a recording lands, each stretch's movie gets its own cursor file.")
r("Cursor file found on import","Importing a movie looks beside it for a same-named .fjcursor and takes it only if it reads as a cursor file made for exactly this movie's size.",["File ▸ Add Media…","drop","open"],["import_media"],details=["A missing, damaged or wrong-size file is left alone and the movie imports without it.","A copy Frame Job makes of a WebM or Matroska file is not looked beside."],area="media")
r("Cursor file on relink","Relinking takes the cursor file beside the new movie, else keeps the existing one if it's still there and the new movie is the same size.",["Relink…","Media tab"],["relink_media"],details=["Otherwise the media has no cursor file after the relink."],area="media")
r("Cursor file on consolidate","Consolidate copies the cursor file into the package beside its movie, and a moved package finds it again.",["Consolidate Media"],["consolidate_media"],area="media")
r("Media tab Cursor section","Selecting a recording in the Media tab names its cursor file, says \"No cursor file\", or adds \"— missing\".",["Media tab ▸ Cursor"],area="media")
r("Locate cursor file","Chooses a .fjcursor file for a recording, taken only if it's a cursor file made for exactly this size; otherwise says why and changes nothing.",["Media tab ▸ Cursor ▸ Locate…"],["set_media_cursor"],details=["Undo name \"Locate Cursor File\"."],area="media")
r("Remove cursor file","Forgets the cursor file, which stays on disk.",["Media tab ▸ Cursor ▸ Remove"],["set_media_cursor"],details=["Undo name \"Remove Cursor File\"."],area="media")
r("get_cursor_events","Agents read a recording's clicks, scrolls, shortcuts, typing stretches and pointer path, in the file's time or a clip's, with each click's place in the clip's zoom region frame.",[],["get_cursor_events"],area="mcp")
r("Clip Cursor section","A clip whose movie has a cursor file the picture doesn't already show gets a Cursor section, after Background; each row is its own undo step.",["Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Cursor"],details=["Starts closed; its summary says off, on or arrow, with + ripples when clicks ripple."])
C="Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Cursor ▸ "
r("Show cursor","Draws the pointer from the file over the clip.",[C+"Show cursor"],details=["On by default.","With an action selected it switches at the action's end."])
r("Cursor Size","Sets how big the pointer is drawn.",[C+"Size"],details=["25–800 %; quick picks 50, 100, 150, 200 and 400 %; the slider runs to 400 %, the field to 800 %.","Animates across a selected action."])
r("Cursor Style","As recorded draws the file's pointer images; Arrow draws Frame Job's own arrow.",[C+"Style"],details=["Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Cursor Smoothing","Calms a shaky path while still passing exactly through every click and holding still where it held still.",[C+"Smoothing"],details=["Off, Light, Medium, Strong.","Belongs to the clip, not an action: the row shows ⊘ with an action selected."])
r("Hide when idle","Fades the pointer out after a set time with no movement or click and brings it back just before it next moves.",[C+"Hide when idle"],details=["Never, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s.","Belongs to the clip, not an action."])
r("Clicks: Ripple","Draws a ring growing out of every click.",[C+"Clicks"],details=["None or Ripple.","Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Ripple color","Sets the ring's colour, with opacity.",[C+"Ripple color"],details=["Live only while Clicks is Ripple.","Switches at a selected action's end."])
r("Ripple size","Sets how big the ring grows.",[C+"Ripple size"],details=["25–400 %.","Live only while Clicks is Ripple.","Animates across a selected action."])
r("Polish","Sets Smoothing to Medium and Hide when idle to 3 s in one step.",[C+"Polish"],details=["Belongs to the clip, not an action."])
r("Cursor settings through actions","With an action selected, Size and Ripple size animate across it and the other rows switch at its end.",[C.rstrip(" ▸")],details=["A clip with no cursor settings gets them the first time you change a row other than Smoothing or Hide when idle with an action selected, so they animate rather than jump."])
r("Mixed rows and Reset in the Cursor section","Selecting clips that disagree shows a row mixed, and Reset puts every row back to its default.",[C+"Reset"])
r("Frame Job's arrow","The arrow is drawn crisp at any size, at a standard pointer's size times Size, and is used whenever the file recorded no pointer images.",[C+"Style ▸ Arrow"])
r("Paste Attributes carries cursor settings","Paste Attributes carries a clip's cursor settings to another clip with the rest of its picture settings.",["Paste Attributes (⌥⌘V)"],area="editing")
r("Cursor motion blur","With the clip's Motion Blur above 0, a moving pointer is drawn streaked along its path across the shutter; a still pointer and click ripples stay sharp.",["Clip tab ▸ Transform ▸ Motion Blur"],["render_frame"],details=["In the preview, render_frame and every export."],area="motion")
r("What a Separate recording lands with","With Cursor Separate the clip gets a Cursor section with the pointer drawn as recorded; with Show Clicks too, Clicks is Ripple in the same undo step.",[],details=["In a new project whose only other change is that, the undo name is \"Cursor Clicks\".","Nothing else is set; Polish is one click away."])
r("What an In the picture recording lands with","The pointer is in the movie, the cursor file says so, and the clip shows no Cursor section, so nothing is drawn twice.")

sec("Shortcuts and Input Monitoring")
r("Recorded shortcuts","Each shortcut is written with its keys spelled out, for example cmd+shift+4.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record shortcuts"],["get_cursor_events"],[IM],["A key held with ⌘ or ⌃ is a shortcut; so is ⌥ with an arrow, Delete, Forward Delete, Return, Enter, Tab or Esc.","⇧ alone never makes one, nor ⌥ with any other key.","Modifiers come first in the order cmd, ctrl, opt, shift, then a named key or the unmodified character lowercased; + is spelled plus."])
r("Typing marks","Every other key press, and every key held until it repeats, is recorded as a time only, never which key.",[PANEL+" ▸ Record shortcuts"],["get_cursor_events"],[IM],["Frame Job doesn't read the character of a typed key at all."])
r("Secure input privacy","Nothing is recorded while any app holds secure input, not even a typing mark.",[],details=["A password field without secure input, such as a Terminal sudo prompt with Secure Keyboard Entry off, is recorded as typing marks only.","Keys pressed while paused aren't recorded.","There is no mode that records what you type."])

sec("Auto Zoom")
A="Clip ▸ Auto Zoom… ▸ "
r("Auto Zoom","Zooms a screen recording in where things happen, from its cursor file: arriving before each click, staying while you work, zooming back out when you stop.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],["auto_zoom"],details=["Each zoom is an ordinary action you can move, retime, change or delete.","The whole plan is one undo step, Auto Zoom.","Works inside an open nest.","Greyed when a selected clip is not a movie with a cursor file."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Zoom","How far in, as a multiple of the clip's own size.",[A+"Zoom"],["auto_zoom"],details=["2× default; 1.25–4."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Arrive","How many seconds before a click the zoom-in starts.",[A+"Arrive"],["auto_zoom"],details=["0.6 s default; 0.2–2."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Stay","How long the zoom holds after the last click or typing.",[A+"Stay"],["auto_zoom"],details=["2.5 s default; 0.5–10."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Follow the cursor while zoomed","Pans along when the pointer stays near the edge of the zoomed view.",[A+"Follow the cursor while zoomed"],["auto_zoom"],details=["On by default.","Adds a half-second pan when the pointer stays outside the middle 70 % of the view for 0.3 s, at most one a second."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Zoom on typing","Zooms in on stretches of typing too, aimed at the last click before them.",[A+"Zoom on typing"],["auto_zoom"],[],["On when there is typing; greyed when the recording holds none.","Never remembered."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Replace existing zooms","Removes the clips' existing zooms first; off keeps your own.",[A+"Replace existing zooms"],["auto_zoom"],details=["Off by default.","Only zooms are removed, never a speed change, a fade or anything else."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom: Motion blur","Gives each zoomed clip a 50 % motion blur (a 180° shutter) so zooms and pans blur along their movement.",[A+"Motion blur"],["auto_zoom motion_blur"],details=["On by default.","A clip that already has a Motion Blur keeps its own.","Agents: motion_blur 0–1, 0.5 by default; the answer's blurred counts the clips given one."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom sheet summary","The sheet reads the cursor files, then says what Zoom would do, or says why a clip can't be planned.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],details=["\"Reading cursor files…\"","e.g. \"5 zooms in 2 visits.\" and \"1 dropped where an action is already set.\""],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom remembers settings","Zoom, Arrive, Stay, Follow, Replace and Motion blur are remembered for next time, once you change one.",["Clip ▸ Auto Zoom…"],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom visits","Clicks and typing are grouped into visits: a zoom-in, a pan to each later click outside the middle 60 % of the view, and a 0.8 s zoom out.",[],["auto_zoom"],details=["A visit starts at a click (any button) or a stretch of typing.","A later click within Stay of the last activity joins it; a longer gap or scrolling ends it.","When one visit would zoom out less than a second before the next zooms in, it pans across instead."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom view stays in the picture","The view keeps the canvas's shape and never shows past the picture's edge, stopping at a corner.",[],["auto_zoom"],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom on split clips","The halves of a split clip are planned as one recording and every zoom out returns to the first half's placement.",[],["auto_zoom"],details=["No zoom crosses a cut.","A zoom held across a cut carries into the next half, which starts zoomed; if that half has its own action there or wasn't selected, the zoom goes out at the cut."],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom respects your actions","A planned zoom that would overlap an action already on the clip is left out.",[],["auto_zoom"],area="motion")
r("Auto Zoom refusals","A clip placed smaller than the canvas, or one that plays reversed, is refused.",[],["auto_zoom"],details=["\"Clip C is placed smaller than the canvas; a zoom would fill the canvas. Nest it (Clip ▸ Nest) and run Auto Zoom inside the nest.\"","Nest it, open the nest and run it there; the zooms then fill the nest."],area="motion")

sec("Shortcut overlays")
r("Add Shortcut Overlays","Shows each shortcut pressed while recording as keycaps at that moment, one Keyboard keys graphic clip per shortcut, bottom and dark, with no sheet.",["Clip ▸ Add Shortcut Overlays"],["add_shortcut_overlays"],details=["Needs a recording made with Record shortcuts on.","One undo step, Add Shortcut Overlays.","Works inside an open nest; greyed when a selected clip is not a movie with a cursor file.","A clip that plays reversed is refused."])
r("Overlay track placement","Overlays go on the front-most track named Shortcuts when it's in front of the clips, unlocked, shown, not a matte and free; otherwise on a new Shortcuts track at the front.",["Clip ▸ Add Shortcut Overlays"],["add_shortcut_overlays"])
